description: This source file defines a PHP class 'EmailNotification' representing email notification entities within the OrangeHRM system. It includes properties, constants, and methods for managing email notification configurations, such as enabling/disabling notifications and associating email subscribers.

classes.name: EmailNotification
classes.description: Entity class representing email notifications, with properties for notification ID, name, enabled status, and associated email subscribers.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the email notification.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the email notification.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the email notification.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the email notification.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the email notification is enabled.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the email notification.

methods.name: getEmailSubscribers
methods.description: Returns the associated email subscribers for this notification.
